versions.title_at_revision: Special condition for rear lift truss.
versions.text: When a rear lift truss is employed, it shall be designed for conditions of reversed airflow at a design speed of: Note: It may be assumed that the value of CL is equal to -0.8 and the chordwise distribution is triangular between a peak at the trailing edge and zero at the leading edge.
